tools.name: search_providers
tools.description: Search the finite public HostDirect catalogue by provider/package name and category. Returns all matches (at most the catalogue size), original price status, source dates and limitations. No ranking or live price guarantee. No pagination.

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: Get one published provider by ID, including selected package, historical/unknown price status, location evidence and source URLs.

tools.name: compare_providers
tools.description: Return 2 to 6 public provider profiles together with evidence and caveats. Compare like-for-like products yourself. Does not calculate a winner, buy hosting or change data.
